question: Who received the Bhavya Bharat Bhushan Award in 2026 for her contributions to sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saina Nehwal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 15, 2026, Sadhguru and Isha Outreach presented the inaugural Bhavya Bharat Bhushan awards to honor individuals who have made extraordinary contributions to India's growth and identity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Sports Category:** **Saina Nehwal** was recognized for her grit and determination, which established India as a powerhouse in world badminton and inspired millions of young athletes.
 
• **Other Awardees:**
 
 
• **Science & Technology:** Dr. Nambi Narayanan (Vikas engine pioneer) and AS Kiran Kumar (Former ISRO Chief).
 
• **Arts & Culture:** Dr. N. Rajam (Violinist) and Shrimati Alarmel Valli (Bharatanatyam).
 
• **Literature:** Dr. Vikram Sampath (Acclaimed historian).
 
 
 
• **National Security:** A special honor was bestowed upon the Armed Forces for their coordination during **Operation Sindoor** (following the Pahalgam attack).
 
• **Objective:** The **'Bhavya Bharat Bhushan'** initiative aims to shift the national narrative from individual success to national contribution, celebrating icons whose work serves as a blueprint for a "Grand India."
 
• **Event:** The awards were launched by Sadhguru in the presence of Union Defence Minister **Rajnath Singh** at the Isha Yoga Center in Coimbatore.
